headline: Denmark's 2025 income tax in Lean reproduces every OECD Taxing Wages line to 1-3 kr. once three undocumented OECD conventions are found (a 15 % occupational pension whose 8 % AM-bidrag is never charged, ATP kept in the AM-bidrag base — an error worth ~227 kr. per worker — and a triple-counted personfradrag line), and shows parents above 917.000 kr. face 56,3 % despite the 52,07 % skatteloft and that marriage moves a spouse's interest income into the other's topskat.
